prompt: Origin: Pocket Garden's Window Box in Autumn, partway through a run on the deployed build at garden.zenwombat.com (bees, sunflowers, a frog and two ponds), played by a scripted Playwright bot that drafts the first seeds, takes the first rule card and plants each packet on its highest-scoring square.
